issues.description: Subroutine name mismatch for the pixel-setting routine: the solution defines the label '.set_pixel' (solution_repository/pixel.asm line 19) while the template, the problem statement and call sites use the identifier 'set_pixel' (template_repository/pixel.asm line 37, problem_statement.md line 31, and solution_repository/pixel.asm line 147). This naming difference means the call instruction 'call set_pixel' will not target the defined '.set_pixel' label, causing an unresolved symbol or incorrect linkage and confusing students who expect the template stub and solution to use the same routine name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Rename the label in solution_repository/pixel.asm from '.set_pixel:' to 'set_pixel:' so it matches the template and problem statement, or alternatively change the call sites and documentation to use '.set_pixel' consistently. Prefer renaming the solution label to 'set_pixel:' to match the template stub and problem description so students can directly map the stub to the working implementation.
